arabic: وَ كَانَ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بَعْدَ هَذَا التَّحْمِيدِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي مَنَّ عَليْنَا بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
دُونَ الْأُمَمِ الْمَاضِيَةِ وَ الْقُرُونِ السَّالِفَةِ ،
بِقُدْرَتِهِ الَّتِي لَا تَعْجِزُ عَنْ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِنْ عَظُمَ ،
وَ لَا يَفُوتُهَا شَيْ‏ءٌ وَ إِنْ لَطُفَ .
فَخَتَمَ بِنَا عَلَى جَمِيعِ مَنْ ذَرَأَ ،
وَ جَعَلَنَا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى مَنْ جَحَدَ ،
وَ كَثَّرَنَا بِمَنِّهِ عَلَى مَنْ قَلَّ .
اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ أَمِينِكَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ ،
وَ كَاشَفَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ إِلَيْكَ حَامَّتَهُ
وَ قَطَعَ فِي إِحْيَاءِ دِينِكَ رَحِمَهُ .
وَ قَرَّبَ الْأَقْصَيْنَ عَلَى اسْتِجَابَتِهِمْ لَكَ .
و أَدْأَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِي تَبْلِيغِ رِسَالَتِكَ
وَ مَحَلِّ النَّأْيِ عَنْ مَوْطِنِ رَحْلِهِ ،
وَ مَسْقَطِ رَأْسِهِ ، وَ مَأْنَسِ نَفْسِهِ ،
وَ اسْتِنْصَاراً عَلَى أَهْلِ الْكُفْرِ بِكَ .
حَتَّى اسْتَتَبَّ لَهُ مَا حَاوَلَ فِي أَعْدَائِكَ
وَ اسْتَتَمَّ لَهُ مَا دَبَّرَ فِي أَوْلِيَائِكَ .
وَ هَجَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي بُحْبُوحَةِ قَرَارِهِمْ
حَتَّى ظَهَرَ أَمْرُكَ ، وَ عَلَتْ كَلِمَتُكَ ، وَ لَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ .
حَتَّى لَا يُسَاوَى فِي مَنْزِلَةٍ ، وَ لَا يُكَافَأَ فِي مَرْتَبَةٍ ،
وَ لَا يُوَازِيَهُ لَدَيْكَ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ ، وَ لَا نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ .
وَ عَرِّفْهُ فِي أَهْلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَ أُمَّتِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ
transliteration: Wa kāna min du‘ā’ihi ‘alayhi-s-salāmu ba‘da hādhā-t-taḥmīdi fi-ṣ-ṣalāti ‘alā Rasūli-llāhi ṣallā-llāhu ‘alayhi wa ālih
Wa-l-ḥamdu lillāhi-lladhī manna ‘alaynā bi-Muḥammadin nabiyyihi ṣallā-llāhu ‘alayhi wa ālih
Bi-qudratihi-llatī lā ta‘jizu ‘an shay’in wa in ‘aẓum,
Wa lā yafūtuhā shay’un wa in laṭuf.
Wa qaṭa‘a fī iḥyā’i dīnika raḥimah.
Wa ad’aba nafsahu fī tablīghi risālatik
Wa masqaṭi ra’sih, wa ma’nasi nafsih,
Ḥattā-statabba lahu mā ḥāwala fī a‘dā’ik
Wa-statamma lahu mā dabbara fī awliyā’ik.
Ḥattā ẓahara amruk, wa ‘alat kalimatuk, wa law kariha-l-mushrikūn.
Ḥattā lā yusāwā fī manzilatin, wa lā yukāfa’a fī martabah,
Wa lā yuwāziyahu ladayka malakun muqarrabun, wa lā nabiyyun mursal.
translation: And it was from his supplications, peace be upon him, after this praise, in invoking blessings upon the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his Household
And praise belongs to God who favoured us with Muhammad, His Prophet, may God bless him and his Household,
above the past nations and bygone generations,
through His power which nothing can incapacitate, however great,
and nothing can escape it, however subtle.
So He sealed with us all whom He created,
and made us witnesses over those who denied,
and made us numerous by His grace over those who were few.
O God, so bless Muhammad, Your trustee over Your revelation,
Your chosen one from Your creation,
and Your elite from Your servants,
the Imam of mercy, the leader of good,
and the key to blessing.
As he dedicated himself to Your command,
And exposed his body to hardship for Your sake,
And confronted his kinsfolk in calling [them] to You,
And fought his clan for Your good pleasure,
And severed his ties of kinship in reviving Your religion.
And he distanced the nearest [of kin] for their denial,
And brought near the farthest [of people] for their response to You.
And he allied with the most distant for Your sake,
And showed enmity to the nearest [of kin] for Your sake.
And he exerted himself in delivering Your message,
And he exhausted it [his soul] in calling to Your creed.
And he occupied it with giving sincere counsel to the people of Your call,
And he migrated to the land of exile,
and the place of remoteness from the home of his belongings,
and the station of his foot,
and his birthplace, and the familiar comfort of his soul,
desiring thereby to exalt Your religion,
and seeking victory over those who disbelieved in You.
Until what he sought against Your enemies was set aright for him,
And what he planned for Your friends was completed for him.
So he rose against them, seeking an opening through Your help,
and strengthening himself against his weakness through Your aid,
So he raided them in the heart of their abodes.
And he attacked them in the midst of their dwellings,
Until Your command became manifest, and Your word exalted, though the polytheists disliked it.
O God, so elevate him for what he strove for Your sake
to the highest degree of Your Garden,
So that he is not equalled in station, nor matched in rank,
nor does any angel brought nigh or prophet sent forth parallel him with You.
And make known to him, concerning his pure Household and his believing community,
from the excellence of intercession,
the greatest of what You promised him.
O He whose promise is ever fulfilled,
O He whose word is true,
O He who replaces evil deeds with multiples of good deeds,
Indeed, You are the Possessor of immense grace.
